preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= R <= 100 and 1 <= G <= 100 and 1 <= B <= 100 and 1 <= M <= 100 for R, G, B, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, R, G, B, and M are between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= r_i <= 10**9 for r_i in r) for r in r_values)
preconditions.description: Each red potion amount r_i is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= g_i <= 10**9 for g_i in g) for g in g_values)
preconditions.description: Each green potion amount g_i is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b) for b in b_values)
preconditions.description: Each blue potion amount b_i is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(1 <= result <= 10**9 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result == min(max(r), max(g), max(b)) for result, (r, g, b) in zip(results, transformed_values))
postconditions.description: Each result is the minimum possible maximum amount of liquid among the transformed potions.
